title: Lycée Blockade Protests Spread to Paris, Rennes, Marseille and Clermont-Ferrand as Students Defy Defence Minister
detail: High school students expanded blockade protests across multiple French cities, defying the Defence Minister's order to resume classes. Protest signs referenced police use of tear gas against minors, following the injury of a 15-year-old who lost a hand to a stun grenade the previous day. The movement signals widening discontent with government handling of youth demonstrations.

media.caption: Lycée blockade protests spread across France as students defy Defence Minister

title: Student Protests Expand to 40+ Cities Nationwide Over Education and National Service Policies
detail: Student protests against France's education and national service policies escalated sharply, spreading to more than 40 cities nationwide. The wave began with lycée blockades and rapidly expanded beyond the initial cities as discontent with government youth policies broadened. The scale of the mobilisation represents one of the largest student movements in France in recent years.

media.caption: Student protests over education and national service policies expand to 40+ cities across France

title: Paris Police Ban Pro-Palestine Rally on Third Anniversary of October 7 Hamas Attack
detail: Paris police banned a pro-Palestine demonstration organised by the 'Urgence Palestine' collective, scheduled for the third anniversary of the October 7, 2023 Hamas attack. Authorities cited public order concerns on the commemoration day. The ban reflects ongoing tensions over pro-Palestinian expression in France amid the anniversary.

media.caption: Paris bans Urgence Palestine rally on October 7 third anniversary
